research_question: Can a deterministic explanation compiler cover the complete declared Setup Companion state space, preserve exact evidence provenance in several presentation forms and execute cheaply on Arm without a language model?

separation.rule: Version 5 productizes V4's model-removal decision. It is an exhaustive finite-domain compiler study, not a new language-model or human-comprehension experiment, and its measurements are not pooled with Versions 1–4.

cost_policy: Only free GitHub-hosted standard Arm runners, Python's standard library and repository source. No paid compute, API, subscription, model download or device.

policy.pass_condition: resettable test device; certification, originals, restoration, reboot persistence and Play Protect pass; device owner inactive

variants.name: brief
variants.contract: action plus every decisive reason and exact value

variants.name: detailed
variants.contract: action, decisive reasons and all seven typed evidence values

variants.name: progressive
variants.contract: summary, why, complete evidence list and next step in separately renderable sections

exhaustive_invariants: exactly 648 unique canonical states are generated
every terminal state returns STOP and leave_device_untouched
every non-terminal incomplete state requests the first missing observation in registered order
PASS occurs if and only if the complete pass condition holds
every decisive rule and evidence value is present in every rendering
D0 and P0 represent all seven evidence keys and exact typed values
two independent compilation passes are byte-identical
every provenance and compiled-output hash verifies

claims.primary: The compiler covers the complete declared finite state domain only if all 648 states pass every registered invariant in every rendering and all mutations are rejected.
claims.performance: Native Arm results describe this Python implementation, host image and declared 648-state workload; they are not a universal device benchmark.
claims.human_boundary: No claim that brief, detailed or progressive rendering improves comprehension, trust, accessibility or preference is permitted without a separate registered human study.
claims.formal_boundary: Exhaustive enumeration over a declared finite domain is not presented as theorem-prover formal verification or proof about undeclared states, operating systems or devices.
